hints.tr: Toplamı parantez içine al: `(a + b + c) / 3`; yoksa yalnızca `c` bölünür.
hints.en: Put the sum in parentheses: `(a + b + c) / 3`; otherwise only `c` is divided.

hints.tr:
Çözümün tamamı:

```python
a = float(input("a: "))
b = float(input("b: "))
c = float(input("c: "))
average = (a + b + c) / 3
print(f"{average:.2f}")
```
hints.en:
The full solution:

```python
a = float(input("a: "))
b = float(input("b: "))
c = float(input("c: "))
average = (a + b + c) / 3
print(f"{average:.2f}")
```
